name: Two-state hand-wipe transformation
description: A fixed-phone before/after reveal built as two independently recorded takes joined by a hand covering and uncovering the lens.
lockedGrammar: Two independently generated takes with one identity lineage
Locked low vertical phone camera and matched room geometry
Before-state turn from front to side/side profile to back double-biceps
Hand approaches and covers the lens at the end of shot one
Shot two begins fully occluded, then reveals the changed state
The audio payoff lands on the hand-wipe reveal
Caption is deterministic and appears only over the before take

variables.description: A fictional or authorized identity description used consistently in both takes.
variables.defaultValue: a clearly new fictional young adult with a consistent face and hair across both states
examples: a blonde young woman with a chin-length bob
a Black young man with short tight curls

variables.description: Gender presentation to preserve across the format unless explicitly changed.
Observable non-medical appearance and pose for the opening state.
variables.defaultValue: relaxed posture, softer cheek and jaw contours, relaxed chest and abdomen, no flexing

variables.description: Observable non-medical appearance and pose for the reveal state.
variables.defaultValue: leaner facial contours and visibly flexed chest, shoulders, arms and abdomen
examples: more muscular with a confident posture

variables.defaultValue: dark grey athletic shorts and wireless earbuds

variables.description: Matched environment shared by both takes.
variables.defaultValue: a small ordinary beige bathroom with a ceiling vent, framed wall art and toilet

variables.description: Authorized audio structure or replacement direction.
variables.defaultValue: spoken setup followed by a music beat drop synchronized to the reveal
examples: new motivational voiceover with a beat drop

shots.anchorPromptTemplate: Create {{subject_identity}} with {{gender_presentation}} presentation in {{setting}}, wearing {{before_wardrobe}} and showing {{before_state}}. Preserve the locked low phone framing and warm ordinary indoor light.
shots.motionPromptTemplate: At natural real-time speed, turn from front to side, rotate to a back double-biceps pose, return toward side profile, then reach one hand forward until it covers the lens. Keep {{subject_identity}} and {{before_state}} stable throughout.

shots.anchorPromptTemplate: Begin fully hand-occluded in the same {{setting}}, then reveal {{subject_identity}} with {{gender_presentation}} presentation, wearing {{after_wardrobe}} and showing {{after_state}} under brighter cooler light. Preserve the exact identity established in the opening take.
shots.motionPromptTemplate: Pull the hand away in the first half-second, step back, flex with hands behind the back, adjust the waistband briefly, then turn to a quarter-side pose. Keep the exact same {{subject_identity}} while expressing {{after_state}} at natural real-time speed.

deterministicLayers.template: Render exact text ‘{{caption_text}}’ in bold white centered sans-serif with a subtle dark shadow.
Use this audio policy: {{audio_policy}}. Align the payoff beat to 4790ms.
Join the independently generated takes through their hand-occluded frames; do not use a dissolve or generated morph.

promptExamples: Recreate this format with a blonde woman, black gymwear before, green gymwear after, and the caption ‘90 days with GymLevels’.
Use the same format with a new male character in a bedroom and caption it ‘2 months of GymLevels app’.

notes: Validated with two independent H3 Max Turbo takes and deterministic finishing.
The source was an ad-hoc Phase 0 run, so provenance points to its immutable run manifest; product-created recipes will point to their Fidelity Map hash.
The reusable recipe transfers structure only; source identity, voice, music, logos and exact dialogue remain separately rights-gated.
